name: whiskyfun
description: The data is collected from the Whiskyfun website's listings of distillery flavour profiles. Nodes are flavour descriptors, and hyperedges are distilleries containing the set of descriptors associated with them.

hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

edges_metadata.name: (STRING) Name of the whisky distillery (e.g., Aberfeldy Single Malt Scotch Whisky).
